title: Peanut Crumble Wontons
description: Crispy wontons filled with a peanut crumble mixture, a unique twist on traditional Chinese appetizers.
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together peanut butter, crumble, scallions, and soy sauce.
Add sliced mushrooms to the bowl and mix until combined.
Place a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and place a small spoonful of the peanut crumble mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In batches, fry the wontons until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the wontons on paper towels and serve hot with a side of soy sauce for dipping.
If desired, sprinkle with crumbled flaky pastry for garnish.
